{{Top|leg}}
The '''Stratis Games''' was a sports competition held in [[Hallrin IV]]. At one point, [[Clyngunn]] from the [[ZeHethbra]] team won in the category of [[Multi-Sentient Unarmed Combat Rounds]] of the Stratis Games.
